name: Chris Morillo
strengths: Morillo triggers downhill from the second level and presses run fits without false steps.
Morillo shows lateral chase range — covers sideline to sideline with clean pursuit angles.
Morillo finishes through contact; wraps and drives instead of arm-tackling.
weaknesses: Morillo (6-2 / ~200) still needs more mass and more drop reps to prove every-down coverage.
comparison: Morillo comps to Ernest Jones — 6-2 compact LB mold; triggers downhill, finishes in space, and chases with range before packing full MIKE mass.
projection: Morillo projects as a Year 2 SEC rotation LB (special teams Year 1). Ceiling: every-down WILL/MIKE — the compact Florida-bred second-level piece who can chase, finish, and grow into the box.
schemeFit: Morillo fits a White 3-3-5 second-level LB who can run, finish, and steal snaps on the edge while adding mass.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-08-08 from Hudl sophomore highlights. Comp size-matched to Ernest Jones (6-2).
insiderNotes: Morillo is a compact 6-2 linebacker who triggers downhill, finishes with a wrap in the box, and still has range when flow stretches. Wins with instincts, chase, and finishing — a WILL/MIKE mold as the frame fills.
recruitingStory: Chris Morillo is a 2028 Hudson (FL) ATH/LB · listed 6-2 / ~200 · in-state Florida target with UF process.
angle: Hudson LB tape: trigger + finish + chase range. In-state process.
